relevance_note: Single case report of a female with Danon disease and a LAMP2 variant: "Genetic testing demonstrated a sequence change in the LAMP2 gene, c.815T>G in exon 6".
method_note: Read the full paper by hand; no tables in the paper; JSON assembled with a short Python script in the scratch directory from hand-entered values, then every span checked verbatim against the paper. One in-scope person (label 'patient', rule 5). The adoptive mother who reported night-time rapid breathing is a reporter only (not tested or affected) and gets no row. Age at diagnosis recorded as '14-year-old' because genetic testing was done during the work-up of the presentation at 14 years; the paper does not state an age at diagnosis separately, and age at last evaluation (after three years of neuropsychiatric follow-up) is not stated. Variant type 'missense' recorded from the authors' phrase 'amino acid substitution', not from the HGVS string. Zygosity, inheritance and parental testing not reported (patient adopted). Checklist 'left ventricular hypertrophy' left not reported: the paper excludes hypertrophic cardiomyopathy ('which this patient did not have') but does not address LV wall thickness as such (IVSTd 1.2 cm given without interpretation); the HCM absence is recorded as an excluded phenotypic_features row. Checklist 'late gadolinium enhancement' left not reported: cardiac MRI reports scarring but does not mention gadolinium enhancement. 'Sinus rhythm' on ECG not used to exclude any arrhythmia item. Checklist 'developmental delay' left not reported: the abstract says 'developmental disability' (recorded as an observed phenotypic feature) but the text describes it as learning disabilities, not delay. Normal findings as a whole (vitals within normal limits, unremarkable urinalysis, normal uterus and ovaries, negative pregnancy test) exclude nothing specific and get no rows; 'recent illness' among denied items not recorded as a feature. No contradictions found inside the paper.
